author: reek
body: A classic demoscene plasma, as a [Device] compute kernel. One GPU thread owns one pixel: it derives its (px, py) from the linear thread id, sums a few fixed-point sine waves of position and time into an RGB colour, and writes the packed pixel to the output buffer. The host renders the buffer to a fullscreen quad. No neighbours, no loops -- pure per-pixel compute.

author: reek
body: Each channel is a mid-grey plus a sum of sine waves; the phases are offset so the channels drift apart into rolling colour. px, py come from the thread id.
